description: Fetch a URL and audit every Set-Cookie it sends: name, and whether Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite are present — the three flags that decide whether a cookie survives transport, XSS and CSRF. Session cookies missing flags are exactly how session hijacking happens. Use this when an agent needs to every cookie a URL sets, with missing flags flagged. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_cookie_audit
title: Cookie Security Audit
